S06.name: Decide
S06.line: A proposed fix, with its reasons

vo.S00: Tuesday morning. A health centre in rural Kota runs out of anti-rabies vaccine. The district office finds out on Friday, from a paper register. Forty minutes away, a warehouse had the stock all along.
vo.S01: This is SwasthyaGrid. Built so that Friday never comes.
vo.S02: Every morning starts in the Command Centre. Forty facilities, five districts, and the six numbers that matter, right at the top. The map shows where the pressure is. Below, the risk matrix scores every clinic on stock, beds, staffing and diagnostics, so the worst problems stand out.
vo.S03: Compare districts side by side. Open Kota, and you get its map, every facility, the footfall forecast and the causes behind each risk.
vo.S04: Every clinic has a case file: medicine cover, beds today and next week, doctors, diagnostics, and what's already on its way.
vo.S06: When stock runs low, SwasthyaGrid proposes the fix: where the medicine comes from, how much, how long it takes and how sure it is, with every reason written out. Nothing moves until an officer approves.
vo.S07: Approval hands off to the supply chain console. A planner picks the right vehicle, refrigerated for vaccines, and a driver on shift. Dispatch tracks every truck on real road routes.
vo.S08: Open a shipment for a live ETA, every stage of the journey, the driver, and the cold-chain temperature, minute by minute.
vo.S09: Fleet shows what every truck is carrying, pallet by pallet. Drivers shows who's on shift and how many hours they have left.
vo.S11a: Or just ask it. In Hindi, Hinglish or English.
vo.S11b: The voice agent runs on Gnani.ai speech models. It checks the live data first, shows its working, and answers only from what it finds.
vo.S12: Underneath sit the operational views: stock cover heatmaps, footfall forecasts, bed pressure, doctor attendance, diagnostics, and analytics that explain why a score moved. Every view works for the whole state or a single district.
vo.S13: When the truck arrives, the clinic confirms delivery in its own portal. Stock goes up, and back in the district office, the facility's risk drops. Live, no refresh.
vo.S13alt: When the truck arrives, the clinic confirms delivery in its own portal. Stock goes up, and back in the district office, the case file updates. Live, no refresh.
vo.S14: Every decision is plain, checkable arithmetic. Each district runs on one shared model, so a new state plugs in without a rebuild.
vo.S15: SwasthyaGrid. See it early. Move it fast. Close the loop.
